name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_create_instance
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::CreateInstance allocates a 32-byte COM event sink, initializes the embedded refcount/lock block, installs the event-sink vtable identity, increments the live-count global, writes the out parameter, and returns S_OK or E_OUTOFMEMORY.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The event-sink vtable symbol is modeled as a typed identity table for the factory. Its individual COM callback slots remain separate reconstruction targets.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x43f610 validates stdcall cleanup, 32-byte operator new allocation, embedded WestwoodOnlineUpgradeRefCountAndLock::Init call at offset 4, vtable store using g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink_Vtbl, InterlockedIncrement of g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiInitState.eventSinkLiveCount, out-parameter write, S_OK on a non-null allocation, and E_OUTOFMEMORY when allocation returns null.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_create_instance_smoke verifies S_OK allocation, non-null out pointer, vtable identity, refCount zeroing, usable initialized critical section, and live-count increment before deleting the object.
